caption:
We'd rather be honest than perfect. 🧱

Most graffiti comes off clean. But some tags get etched into glass or soak deep into old brick, and no amount of scrubbing will fully remove them.

When we hit one of those, we won't pretend it's gone. We'll tell you straight and help you figure out the next step, whether that's a repair, a replacement, or a cover-up.

Every time we show up, the goal is the same: leave the block better than we found it. 💛

#Transparency #HamOnt #HammerStreetClean #BartonVillage #GraffitiRemoval #HamiltonON
